en: n. a fast aircraft with an engine that sends out a strong stream of hot gases; a narrow stream of liquid or gas forced out of a small opening; a hard black stone used for jewelry; v. to travel by jet plane; to shoot out in a strong stream; a. very black
ex: The jet took off from the runway at dawn.
噴射機在黎明時從跑道起飛。

en: n. a precious stone, such as a diamond, that is cut and polished; a piece of jewelry made with such stones; a person or thing that is very special or valuable; v. to decorate something with jewels
ex: The crown was decorated with rare jewels.
那頂王冠鑲飾著稀有的寶石。

en: a. full of juice and good to eat; (of a story or news) exciting and full of interesting details about people's private lives; (informal) offering a large reward
ex: The orange was sweet and juicy.
這顆橘子又甜又多汁。

en: n. a thick tropical forest where many plants and animals live; a confused mass of things; a place where life is hard and people fight for success
ex: The explorers spent weeks in the Amazon jungle.
探險家在亞馬遜叢林裡待了好幾週。

en: a. younger; lower in rank or less experienced; n. a person who is younger or has a lower position; (US) a student in the third year of high school or college; a son who has the same name as his father
ex: She is a junior at the university.
她是大學三年級的學生。

en: a large Australian animal with strong back legs for jumping, and a pocket on the front of the female's body for carrying its baby
ex: A kangaroo can jump several meters in one leap.
袋鼠一躍可以跳好幾公尺。

en: a unit of length in the metric system equal to 1,000 meters
ex: The school is two kilometers from my house.
學校離我家兩公里。

en: n. a man in the Middle Ages who fought on a horse and was loyal to a king or lady; a man who has been given the title "Sir" by a king or queen; a chess piece shaped like a horse's head; v. to give someone the title of knight
ex: The knight rode into the castle on a white horse.
騎士騎著白馬進入城堡。

en: v. to make clothes by pulling wool or thread through needles; to join something together closely; to wrinkle your forehead
ex: My grandmother knitted me a warm scarf.
奶奶幫我織了一條保暖的圍巾。

en: adv. in the recent past; not long ago
ex: I haven't seen him lately.
我最近沒看到他。

en: n. the sound or act of laughing; the feeling of being amused
ex: The room was filled with laughter.
房間裡充滿了笑聲。

en: n. clothes, sheets and other things that need to be washed or have just been washed; a place where clothes are washed; the activity of washing clothes
ex: I need to do the laundry this weekend.
這個週末我得洗衣服。

en: n. an area of short, closely cut grass around a house or in a park; a fine thin cotton or linen cloth
ex: He mows the lawn every Saturday morning.
他每週六早上割草坪。

en: n. a small hole through which liquid or gas escapes; the act of secretly giving information; v. to escape through a hole or crack; to secretly give private information to the public
ex: There is a leak in the roof, so water drips into the room.
屋頂漏水，水一直滴進房間裡。

en: v. to jump a long way or to a high position; to move quickly and suddenly; to rise quickly in number or amount; n. a large jump; a sudden increase or change
ex: The cat leaped over the fence in one jump.
貓一躍就跳過了圍籬。

en: n. the strong material made from the skin of animals, used for making shoes, bags and clothes; a. made of leather; v. to cover something with leather; (informal) to beat someone
ex: He bought a pair of leather shoes.
他買了一雙皮鞋。

en: n. time when you are not working or studying and can do what you enjoy; a. used for or relating to free time
ex: She reads novels in her leisure time.
她在閒暇時間讀小說。

en: a large wild cat with yellow fur and dark spots, found in Africa and Asia
ex: A leopard was resting on a tree branch.
一隻豹正在樹枝上休息。
ph: a leopard cannot change its spots

en: n. the freedom to live, think or act as you want; the right to do something; (take liberties) to behave in a way that is too free
ex: People fought for their liberty and rights.
人們為自由與權利而奮戰。

en: v. to pass your tongue over something; (of a flame or water) to touch lightly; (informal) to defeat someone easily; n. an act of licking; a small amount of something; (informal) a quick speed
ex: The dog licked the plate clean.
狗把盤子舔得乾乾淨淨。

en: n. the time that someone is alive; the period during which something exists or works; a. lasting for the whole of someone's life
ex: She worked at the same company for her entire lifetime.
她一輩子都在同一家公司工作。

en: a tall tower built near the sea, with a powerful light that warns ships of danger or guides them
ex: The lighthouse guided the ships safely into the harbor.
燈塔引導船隻安全進港。

en: n. a large white flower shaped like a trumpet, often used to mean purity; a plant with these flowers; a. white; pure and innocent
ex: A white lily floated on the pond.
一朵白百合漂浮在池塘上。

en: a. full of energy and enthusiasm; (of a place or event) busy and exciting; (of colors) bright and vivid
ex: The town is lively on weekends, with crowded night markets.
這座小鎮週末很熱鬧，夜市擠滿了人。

en: n. a large area inside the entrance of a hotel or building; a group of people who try to influence politicians; v. to try to persuade a politician to support something
ex: Let's meet in the hotel lobby at nine.
九點在飯店大廳碰面吧。

en: v. to find the exact position of something; to put something in a particular place; to be in a particular place; (US) to settle in a place
ex: The police were able to locate the missing car.
警方找到了失蹤的車。

en: n. a device for fastening a door or box with a key; a section of a canal with gates that control the water level; a small amount of hair; v. to close something with a key or lock; to be unable to move or to stop something moving
ex: Please lock the door when you leave.
離開時請鎖門。

en: a hard sweet on a stick that you hold and suck
ex: The little boy licked a cherry lollipop happily.
小男孩開心地舔著櫻桃口味的棒棒糖。
ph: 學童過馬路的交通指揮員

en: a. not firmly attached; not tight; (of clothes) loose-fitting; not exact or careful; v. to set free; to fire a shot; n. (on the loose) free and not controlled
ex: The screw on the chair is loose.
椅子上的螺絲鬆了。

en: n. a person who loves another person and has a romantic or sexual relationship with him or her; a person who likes something very much
ex: He is a great animal lover and has three dogs.
他非常愛動物，養了三隻狗。

en: n. bags, suitcases and boxes that you take with you when you travel
ex: Please keep your luggage with you at all times.
請隨時把行李帶在身邊。

en: a. having or seeming to have magic powers; very special and wonderful; relating to the art of magic
ex: The fairy tale takes place in a magical forest.
這個童話發生在一座神奇的森林裡。

en: a person who performs magic tricks to entertain people; a person in stories who has magic powers
ex: The magician pulled a rabbit out of his hat.
魔術師從帽子裡拉出一隻兔子。

en: n. a piece of iron or steel that attracts other pieces of iron or steel; a person or thing that attracts many people
ex: The magnet picked up all the pins from the table.
磁鐵把桌上所有的別針都吸了起來。

en: n. a woman who is paid to clean and cook in a house or hotel; (old) a young girl or unmarried woman
ex: The maid cleaned the hotel room every morning.
女服務員每天早上打掃飯店房間。

en: n. the larger part of a group; more than half of the total; the number by which the votes for one side are greater than the votes for another
ex: The majority of students agreed with the new rule.
大多數學生同意這項新規定。

en: n. a pen with a thick tip used for writing or drawing; something that shows the position of something; a person who marks a score in a game; a sign or event that shows an important stage in something
ex: She underlined the key words with a red marker.
她用紅色麥克筆在重點字下面畫線。

en: a. extremely good or surprising; making you feel great pleasure or admiration
ex: We had a marvelous time at the beach.
我們在海邊玩得非常開心。

en: a. relating to or using mathematics; very exact and careful; (of a chance) possible in theory
ex: He solved the mathematical problem in five minutes.
他五分鐘就解出了這道數學題。

en: a field of grass, often with wild flowers, especially one used for animals to eat
ex: Cows were grazing in the green meadow.
乳牛在綠色的草地上吃草。
